title: Last-round differential fault analysis on a toy SPN
description: Analyze a 16-bit, 4-round substitution-permutation network (SPN) cipher implemented in Verilog together with a set of correct/faulty ciphertext trace pairs collected under a fixed but undisclosed single-nibble transient fault model. Identify the exploitable register, localize the fault in time and nibble position, recover the affected final-round subkey nibble via differential fault analysis, and propose concrete hardening measures.

metrics.name: leakage_detection_accuracy
metrics.description: Binary correctness of identifying the vulnerable register, fault cycle offset, and affected nibble index against hidden ground truth; all three must match for full credit.

metrics.name: fault_coverage
metrics.description: Whether the reported fault location/cycle, when re-simulated with iverilog/vvp, reproduces the differential ciphertext patterns present in trace_pairs.json.

metrics.name: hardening_precision
metrics.description: Fraction of submitted hardening_recommendations entries that are semantically valid, concrete fault-hardening techniques applicable to the identified register, as opposed to generic or irrelevant advice.

metrics.name: key_recovery_correctness
metrics.description: Whether the recovered subkey nibble index and value exactly match the unique survivor of brute-force differential elimination over the 16 candidate nibble values against trace_pairs.json.

metrics.name: schema_conformance
metrics.description: Whether the submitted vulnerability_report.json satisfies all structural, type, and format functional requirements for the report.

constraints: Do not modify any files under inputs/; submit only the answer file under submission/.
The only graded artifact is submission/vulnerability_report.json.
All artifacts under inputs/ are self-contained and simulatable with iverilog/vvp without proprietary IP.
